title: Sensitivity-aware quant profiles for reranker: slicewise calibration and norm-preservation audit
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: produce a set of sensitivity-aware quantization profiles (FP8 and INT8 candidates) for the production reranker that preserve rank ordering across high-priority slices while enabling 1.6–2.5x throughput improvements.

This ticket covers: (1) a slicewise calibration workflow (per-slice activation/statistics collection + per-layer scale/bias correction), (2) a set of norm-preservation heuristics for embedding/attention layers to avoid drift in dot-product magnitudes, and (3) an evaluation matrix (NDCG@10, MRR@10) with statistical significance testing and rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Calibrated FP8 and INT8 profiles documented and checked into model-profile registry
No slice in the high-priority slice list shows a relative NDCG@10 drop > 0.6% (p<0.05) compared to baseline full-precision
End-to-end inference throughput improvement of at least 1.6x on target GPU (A10G) for INT8 profile and 2.0x for FP8 profile under production batching distribution
Playbook describing deploy/rollback steps, per-slice thresholds, and monitoring alerts created and reviewed
Calibration artifacts (calibration cache, histograms, bias correction params) stored in S3 path and linked in ticket
experiment_plan: 1) Create slice list: Top-20 high-traffic queries, tail long queries, exact-match heavy queries, cross-device mix. 2) Collect activation stats (per-layer min/max, histograms, mean/var) on a 50k sample per slice from offline replay. 3) Run calibration variants: global KL, per-channel MSE with bias correction, stochastic rounding with 128-sample seed. 4) Produce candidate profiles: int8-global, int8-perchannel, fp8-e4m3, fp8-e5m2 with per-layer override for embeddings and final dense. 5) Run distributed k-fold reranker evaluation (k=10) measuring NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR@10, compute bootstrap CIs and paired t-tests vs baseline. 6) If any high-priority slice shows degradation beyond gate, iterate on per-layer overrides or fall back to mixed-precision for that layer.
evaluation_metrics: Throughput (tokens/sec) and p50/p95 latency under production load profile
CPU/GPU memory footprint and execution flakiness (OOMs/retries)
calibration_steps: Run stat collection job (stat-collector v2) with per-slice tagging
Compute per-channel scales using MSE fit with L2 regularization (lambda=1e-6)
Apply bias correction on output projection layers where mean drift > 0.02 stddev
Validate numeric stability with 1k deterministic seeds using stochastic rounding disabled/enabled
Record layerwise quantization error and activation norm ratios to detect norm collapse
rollout_plan: Canary rollout on dedicated pool: 5% of traffic to INT8 profile, 0% FP8 initially. Monitor NDCG and MRR via live evaluation harness (30 min rolling windows). If observed per-slice NDCG drop > 0.6% for 3 consecutive windows OR absolute MRR degradation > 0.3% -> immediate rollback. If stable for 24 hours and metrics within gates, increase to 30% and then 100% over 72h.
notes: Preliminary runs show embedding projection layers are most sensitive to INT8 symmetric quant; per-channel thresholding helped for 3 sensitive layers
FP8 candidate with e4m3 preserved MRR on short-query slices but underperformed on long-conversation slices due to KV cache quant noise
We will prefer mixed-precision overrides for attention output and final logits if needed
Plan to add a small calibration set of 'anchor queries' that represent critical legal/regulatory queries for enterprise customers
